hypothesis: To determine whether K-means clustering with PCA dimensionality reduction recovers income strata more consistently with predefined income thresholds than hierarchical clustering or fuzzy c-means methods.
author: coder-agent
baseline: Predefined income thresholds ('>50K' vs '<=50K') serving as ground truth for cluster alignment
success_criteria: K-means with PCA will show higher Adjusted Rand Index and Normalized Mutual Information scores compared to hierarchical clustering and fuzzy c-means when evaluated against predefined income thresholds, indicating better recovery of income strata consistency.
